title: Circuit Breaker (Nine-O-Three To Forty)
style: minimal synth-pop, 100 bpm, on-off hook arpeggio, breaker-trip stop-starts, gated reverb claps, cold deterministic monosynth bassline, dry vocals confident and dry, accountant disco mood, 336 hz subharmonic under the bass, clean low-budget triumph
lyrics:
[Intro]
(click) Breaker armed
(click) Breaker holds

[Verse 1]
Nine hundred and three was the bill that came due
Burn rate climbing on what we used to do
Every embedding, every redundant call
Bleeding the ledger, dropping the ball

[Pre-Chorus]
Then we drew the line, then we set the cap
Seventy percent off the API map

[Chorus]
Nine-oh-three to forty, breaker holds the floor
Spending what we said we'd spend, not a dollar more
Nine-oh-three to forty, the budget sings
Three-three-six, deterministic things

[Verse 2]
Thirty thousand calls eliminated clean
Cache the constants, idempotent routine
Reuse the answer when the question's the same
That's not a shortcut, that's the actual game

[Chorus]
Nine-oh-three to forty, breaker holds the floor
Spending what we said we'd spend, not a dollar more
Nine-oh-three to forty, the budget sings
Three-three-six, deterministic things

[Bridge]
When the threshold trips, the system falls back
Graceful, graceful, never off the track

[Outro]
(click) Breaker armed
(click) Budget held
(click) Done
